catalysts.headline: BIO-key reported Q3 2026 results: total revenue ~$1.48M (vs ~$1.55M Q3 2025, ~-4.5% YoY); license fee revenue +39% YoY to $1,275,249 (86% of total revenue); hardware revenue fell to $12,404 from $363,642; gross margin improved to 90% from 77%; operating loss narrowed to $(820,213); net loss narrowed to $(886,083) from $(964,849); 9M 2026 net loss improved 42% YoY to $(1,667,972) from $(2,868,790)
catalysts.impact: Narrowing losses and margin expansion on a roughly flat top line; company cited an 'enhanced post-quarter balance sheet' supporting 2026 growth goals

catalysts.headline: BIO-key announced it will report Q3 2026 results before market open on Friday, November 13, 2026, with an investor call at 10am ET led by CEO Mike DePasquale and CFO Cecilia Welch
Reconvened 2026 annual meeting closed its final proposal

Reconvened 2026 annual meeting closed its final proposal: stockholders approved Proposal 4, authorizing issuance of up to 1,236,668 shares issuable on exercise of warrants from the Aug 10, 2026 warrant inducement transaction. Final vote: 129,795 for, 89,849 against, 648 abstain, 0 broker non-votes — passes even counting abstentions as against.
